scope: Price-only complete inventory of the retained 285 NHL payloads. No sporting outcome or feature files read; no model, fair probability, EV, selection threshold, settlement, return, or betting claim.

method.join: Same raw event payload, exactly one FanDuel bookmaker and one of each literal market. Exact identical player description; no normalization, aliases, NHL ID mapping, or eventual participation.
method.goal_pair: Exactly one Over and one Under at numeric point 0.5; Anytime requires exactly one Yes and no point. All compared prices finite numeric American with abs>=100.
method.time_alignment: Strict equality of parsed UTC market last_update clocks. Nonzero deltas are reported separately, with sign Anytime minus goal market. Provider prestart/72h checks are descriptive; independent fixture starts were not read.
method.price_comparison: Compare exact rational decimal returns: 1+A/100 for positive A, 1+100/abs(A) for negative A. No tolerance or threshold; differences are offer payout differences only.
method.cohort: All archive quote overlaps, including the old debug game and unresolved global names; this is not the 2768-row PP-model entry cohort. No retrospective fixture/roster/outcome exclusions.

odds_api.finding: NHL table maps player_goals to Goals (Over/Under), and player_goal_scorer_anytime to Anytime Goal Scorer (Yes/No). Names do not establish historical operator settlement.

fanduel.finding: NHL player propositions include regulation and overtime unless expressly limited; shootout player stats excluded unless stated. Full-game/60-minute player bets need any time on ice; otherwise void. Ice-hockey text supplies generic player-proposition rules, not an explicit crosswalk for these API market keys.

primary_rules_review.inference: Current names plus generic NHL player-prop rules are consistent with the same goal event under ordinary full-game mapping. Historical 2024-25 feed-market equivalence, market-specific exceptions, jurisdiction, and accepted execution are unverified; no unconditional payoff-equivalence claim.

limitations: Equal market timestamps are provider update labels, not independent receipt clocks, atomic updates, suspension status, or executable offers.
Only one retained snapshot per event; cannot establish persistence or causal market response.
Anytime is Yes-only in these files; no Anytime No counterpart exists here.
Price differences occur within a small number of events; repeated player rows are not independent events.
Exactly two primary rule URLs were read. No further source hunt, model evaluation, or sporting outcomes were used.
